Talencia is looking for a “Data Business Analyst” for one of its clients.

Location : Brussels

Start date : ASAP

Duration : Long term vision

 

Context :

We are looking for an experienced Data Business Analyst to bridge the gap between business stakeholders and Data Engineering teams. In this role, you will play a key part in translating business needs into scalable data solutions while supporting the transformation from an SAP-based landscape to a modern cloud data platform. You will contribute to both the maintenance of the current SAP BW environment and the evolution of the future data architecture.

Description :

As a Data Business Analyst, you will gather and analyse business requirements, translating them into functional and technical data specifications. You will design data mappings, transformation logic, and KPI definitions, while collaborating on conceptual and logical data models. Your responsibilities will also include SQL analysis, data profiling, and data quality assessments, as well as producing Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Specifications. You will lead root cause analyses for data discrepancies and pipeline issues, define and execute testing and UAT activities, and contribute to data governance through documentation and metadata management. A strong background in SAP BW, SAP data extraction processes, SQL, data warehousing (ETL, Star/Snowflake schemas), and logical and physical data modelling is essential. Experience with Google BigQuery, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), SAP SD/MM, or within a retail or large enterprise environment is considered an asset.
 

Your Profile :

You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, Engineering, Economics, or a related field, and have proven experience as a Data Business Analyst or in a similar consulting role. You are comfortable working at the intersection of business and technology, with excellent communication skills that enable you to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are analytical, solution-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment. Fluency in English is mandatory, together with French or Dutch.

In case of interest in this job, please send us immediately your updated resume.
